reviewNotes.2071: Two distinct single-leg hip-thrust positions, working foot planted and free knee lifted; pelvis rises to near shoulder-hip-knee alignment. reviewNotes.2072: Distinct lowered and lifted bilateral hip thrust, both feet planted, hips reach approximately level torso and thighs. Bench appears to support forearms rather than clearly contacting upper back; red glute overlay contains radial fibers through shorts. Correct upper-back support and plain teaching tint. Qualified review of shin angle, pelvis level and lumbar control.
reviewNotes.2087: Single coherent standing figure with extended working arm, but assisting hand is near shoulder rather than just above elbow, and arm projects forward rather than clearly drawing across chest.
